mentions.name: dawgdic/Haskell port
mentions.description: A work-in-progress Haskell port of the dawgdic C++ library implementing the DAWG (directed acyclic word graph) data structure, being built to understand DAWG internals as part of the morphological analysis behind the author's anti-spam bot plugin.
mentions.source_excerpt: More precisely, right now it is about understanding DAWG data structure by porting it from C++[2] to Haskell[3].
